# crosswork_port_groups (Data Source)

This data source can read the Port Groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_port_groups" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Group description
- `name` (String) Group name, unique among the port groups without regard to case
- `parent_uuid` (String) Id of the parent group, which is the built-in `User Defined` group, the group of the `crosswork_groupings` data source for the classifier `UserDefinedPorts` that is built in (`discovery_type` is `StaticSystem`) and allows subgroups (`subgroups_allowed`)
